Testimonials  
What our customers say

OCBC Centre

“As a sustainability focused bank, OCBC is pleased to partner with Charge+ to enable OCBC Centre to be the biggest EV charging hub in the Central Business District. With 10 EV charging points, visitors to OCBC Centre and employees of OCBC will be able to convert to electric vehicles without worrying about not having EV chargers near where they live and stay. We are very pleased that the EV chargers have worked reliably and the Charge+ team has been responsive to all the queries! Because of this trust and partnership, we have plans to continue working with Charge+ to extend EV chargers to more of our buildings to do our part in accelerating the EV transition for Singapore.”

​

– Lee Shyong, Managing Director, Public Sector/Partnership & Innovation, Global Corporate Banking
